belief.body: Growth shouldn't be limited by the size of your business. With the right strategy, technology and execution, every business can move forward — regardless of where it's starting from.

website.tagline: A digital presence that works for your business — not just one that exists.
website.desc: A website isn't just an online brochure. We build sites that act as a convincing first touchpoint — fast, clear, and designed so visitors know exactly what to do the moment they land.
website.suitedFor: Businesses with no real digital presence yet, or whose old website no longer reflects the quality of what they do today.

web-app.tagline: Turn manual processes into a system that runs itself.
web-app.desc: If your business still runs on spreadsheets, manual WhatsApp broadcasts, or pen-and-paper records, it's time for a system built around how you actually work. We build dashboards and internal tools tailored to your business.
web-app.suitedFor: Businesses whose operations have grown too complex to run manually and now need a system of their own.

mobile-app.tagline: Show up where your customers spend most of their time.
mobile-app.desc: A mobile app isn't just about prestige — it's about convenience. We build Android, iOS, or cross-platform apps that make it effortless for your customers to come back, no browser required.
mobile-app.suitedFor: Businesses with high repeat-order customers who need a closer way to stay connected.

digital-marketing.tagline: Not just running ads — managing them for results.
digital-marketing.desc: Effective digital marketing isn't about a bigger budget, it's about the right strategy on the right platform. We manage your ads on whichever platforms actually match your audience and business goals.
digital-marketing.suitedFor: Businesses with a solid product or service that just isn't known enough yet, or whose traffic has plateaued.

ai-automation.tagline: Let the system work overtime, not your team.
ai-automation.desc: From automating repetitive work to AI agents built around your specific business process — we help make your business smarter and more efficient without adding headcount.
ai-automation.suitedFor: Businesses whose teams are overwhelmed by repetitive work, or ready to explore an AI agent for sales, research, or content production.

branding.tagline: Before the website, before the content, before the ads — your business needs a clear identity first.
branding.desc: This is the root problem that often gets missed: plenty of prospects come asking for a website or content, when their logo was thrown together and there's no color or font guide to speak of. Branding Services fills that foundation, and naturally becomes the gateway into a Website or Content Production package.
branding.suitedFor: New businesses that need a usable logo fast, or businesses serious about building a long-term brand.

content-production.tagline: Content that's consistent with your brand, not a generic template used for everyone.
content-production.desc: Unlike generic feed design services where you just fill in a template, TRIGIA's content follows the brand guideline already built for you — so your Instagram feed reads as a continuation of your brand, not a separate add-on. It's also a natural complement to our Digital Marketing service.
content-production.suitedFor: Businesses just starting to post consistently, up to those making Instagram/TikTok their main acquisition channel.

work.heading: Built to Make an Impact.

cases.title: Rumi Home Spa
cases.challenge: Before the website, new customers could only discover Rumi Home Spa through a WhatsApp chat — with no place to build trust before booking.
cases.solution: A full booking website showcasing services and therapist credibility, with a direct WhatsApp booking flow — designed to build trust before the first message is even sent.
cases.result: Now Rumi Home Spa's primary digital front door — the first touchpoint for every new customer before they book.

cases.title: Rumi Inner Circle
cases.challenge: The loyalty program was run manually, with no way for members to track points or refer friends on their own.
cases.solution: A member portal with a dashboard, real-time points tracking, and a referral system — turning loyal customers into part of an exclusive community.
cases.result: Loyal customers now have self-service access to their rewards, anytime.

cases.title: Kwartir Ranting Pramuka Sambit
cases.challenge: An organization overseeing 18 scout troops across the district had no digital presence — activity updates and contact info spread by word of mouth only.
cases.solution: An organization profile website showcasing their structure, activity agenda, and documentation gallery — giving Kwarran Sambit a digital identity worth trusting.
cases.result: Schools, troop leaders, and parents now have one official place to learn about and reach Kwarran Sambit.

work.note: * More case studies will be added as TRIGIA takes on new projects.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on complexity — websites usually take 2–4 weeks, while web or mobile apps can take 6–12 weeks. You'll get a clear timeline upfront, before the project starts.
We use a milestone-based payment system (initial down payment, then installments tied to progress) to keep things easier on your business's cash flow.

items.q: I'm not technical — is that a problem?
items.a: Not at all. That's exactly our job — translating your business needs into the right technical solution, without you needing to understand any code.

items.q: Is there a revision guarantee after the project is done?
items.a: Yes, every project includes a revision period after handover. For ongoing support, we also offer a separate maintenance package.

items.q: Can I consult first before deciding?
items.a: Of course — we offer a free initial consultation to understand your needs before any formal proposal.

about.heading: We Believe Digital Should Move Business Forward.
about.paragraph1: TRIGIA was born from real experience, not theory. Before founding TRIGIA, our founder built an entire digital ecosystem for their own business from scratch — an automated booking system, a member portal, a financial document system, and WhatsApp Business integration for day-to-day operations.
about.paragraph2: That experience shapes how TRIGIA works today — we understand business because we've built systems that are actually used, not just concepts on paper.
